correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the four-frequency moment sum over sample indices: E|sum exp(ikTheta)|^4=2n^2-n, and for distinct positive k,l, E[A_k A_l]=n^2, even when one frequency is a multiple of the other. Uniformity eliminates every nonzero net frequency. Parseval for the mean-centered circular empirical process gives U_n^2=(2*pi^2)^-1 sum_{k>=1} Z_{n,k}/k^2. Square summability ensures L2 convergence; zeta(2), zeta(4) yield E U_n^2=1/12, Var U_n^2=(n-1)/(360n), and the exact cross-correlation. This proves finite uncorrelatedness, NOT independence.
